Updated: Last updated: 10/4/69. I went for a dental check-up because of receding gums. The doctor examined me very thoroughly and gave excellent advice. It took half an hour. As a returning customer, the doctor said there was no charge.

It's not that the service was free, because I know clinics have costs and need to make a profit. But I could feel that the doctor had a true spirit; it was more than just profit or customers. The doctor genuinely cared for the patient.

------

I also had a wisdom tooth extracted. The doctor gave excellent advice, was professional and experienced. The equipment was clean, and the air conditioning was cool. I highly recommend this clinic. The prices are fair.

I highly recommend this dental clinic to anyone looking for a good dental treatment.
